Zoe (DevRel): pushing a tiny rollout idea: OpenRef Toolkit 1 two micro-tutorials, one reference app, and a compact benchmark note + 30-min live lab. objective: quick wins for new devs and measurable inbound. volunteers?
Ray (Growth): yes. KPIs: RSVPs, repo forks, trial starts. propose UTMs and 3 segments for routing.
Maya (Content): I can write the launch post and the 2 tutorials (GIFs). will draft social + email. need a hero stat from Ibrahim.
Ibrahim (PMM): bench angle: show Optimize preset vs baseline; hero stat idea: "~36% lower per-token cost with prefix caching + quant". draft bench cmd: `./bench.sh --model rwd-mini --seq 320 --batch 12 --cache prefix --quant int8`
June (Design): I'll produce hero image + 3 step GIF templates. need final art 48h before publish.
release-bot: assets uploaded: drive.redwood.ai/openref-toolkit/assets (starter-repo + slides + gifs)
Zoe (DevRel): funnel: blog -> tutorial A -> tutorial B -> workshop signup -> post-lab bench email. routing tags: openref_visited, openref_registered, openref_attended, openref_forked. high-engagement -> SEops.
Ray (Growth): sample UTM: `?utm_source=openref-toolkit&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=openref_launch`. will wire hidden field `source=openref` on the form.
Maya (Content): short social copy options: "OpenRef Toolkit: 2 micro-tutorials and a hands-on lab to ship an LLM microfeature in 30 mins. RSVP." email subject: "Ship a mini LLM feature in 30 minutes 1 OpenRef Toolkit"
Ibrahim (PMM): will publish raw bench logs in repo and prep a 2-slide "how we measured" for the lab.
Zoe (DevRel): owners: Maya=copy & tutorials, Ibrahim=bench + numbers, June=design, Ray=distribution & routing, Zoe=webinar ops + repo maintainer. agreed?
All: :+1:
Maya (Content): checklist: quickstart README, 3 gifs, sample inputs, bench logs, slides, CTAs (star repo, start trial). I'll open PR tomorrow morning.
release-bot: opened PR: github.com/redwood-inference/openref-toolkit/pull/9 (initial tutorial + assets)
Ray (Growth): routing rules: attendees -> tag:openref_attended; forks -> tag:openref_forked; attend+fork -> SEops_high. webhook will include `source=openref`.
Zoe (DevRel): action items: add ETAs to PR and flag blockers by EOD. 24h reminder before publish, @release-bot please ping.
release-bot: scheduled reminder set: 24h before publish to #marketing
Ibrahim (PMM): hero stat provisional until bench run completes. will push logs by EOD and confirm numbers.
Maya (Content): once hero stat is green, I'll schedule the blog + socials. excited to ship a compact, developer-first kit that drives high-quality signals. :sparkles:
